[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Welcome,
Hi, Im a single newbie modder making a simple farm based from harvest town maps game layout. I made it as close to the original as possible.
farmland there is a section for planting seeds to look after animals and ADD a NEW STORE next to your house. Foxy as the seller.
sell seeds according to VannilaSeed same as Pierre general shop.The map design is mixed with beaches, villages, and small gardens that you can decorate.
